title: Sphere mapping spaces preserve weak homotopy equivalences
statement: Use k-spaces and the k-space topology from [lem-coef-realization-finite-limits], and continuous based homotopy groups and path components from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a continuous map of topological spaces inducing a bijection on path components and isomorphisms of all positive homotopy groups at every basepoint. For $r\geq0$ put $S^r=\{v\in\mathbb R^{r+1}:\|v\|=1\}$ and put $S^{-1}=\varnothing$. For every integer $r\geq-1$, postcomposition induces a weak homotopy equivalence $k\operatorname{Cont}(S^r,X)\to k\operatorname{Cont}(S^r,Y)$. Here $\operatorname{Cont}(K,Z)$ carries the compact-open topology generated by $[L,U]=\{h:h(L)\subseteq U\}$ for compact $L\subseteq K$ and open $U\subseteq Z$, and weak homotopy equivalence means the same bijection and based-group isomorphisms as for $f$.
